dedupe_keys.name: major industrial plant database mipd energy use of about 15 000 major us industrial plants ihs markit now s p global

description: A commercial database of the energy use of large US industrial plants. The IHS Markit product sheet (May 2017) says MIPD gives detailed energy-use data on about 15,000 major US industrial plants in 19 industries, representing 85 percent of the natural gas consumed by the industrial sector, with 86 data elements per plant kept current by daily telephone surveys: plant name, address and latitude and longitude, plant manager contacts, products, SIC and NAICS codes, employees, hours of production, capacity utilisation and value of shipments, electric utility, use, demand and price, cogeneration share, gas utility and use, fuel use by boiler, furnace or feedstock, steam demand, pressure and temperature, number and rating of boilers with their fuels, and directly connected pipelines and pipelines within 20 miles. It is sold by subscription to power and gas marketers; the licence is the vendor's terms and the delivery format is not stated on the sheet read. Coverage is the United States. Caveats: a 2017 product sheet, so current availability under S&P Global was not confirmed. For simulation it links plants to their electric and gas utilities and pipelines, which is exactly what outage propagation from energy networks to industry needs. A related catalogue record is the NREL industrial facility combustion energy use data.
